description: This file defines the class 'testproject' which manages test project data within the TestLink system. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting test projects, as well as handling related entities such as keywords, requirements, and user roles. The class interacts with various database tables and other components to facilitate comprehensive test project management.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: Represents a test project within TestLink, providing methods for managing projects, associating keywords, handling requirements specifications, managing user roles, and performing CRUD operations on test project data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test project in the system, inserting related data into the database, generating API keys, and optionally setting session variables.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing test project information in the database, including attributes like name, color, notes, and options, and triggers related events.

methods.name: setSessionProject
methods.description: Sets or unsets session variables associated with a specific test project.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves test project data based on its name.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves test project data based on its unique identifier.

methods.name: get_by_prefix
methods.description: Retrieves test project data based on its prefix code.

methods.name: getByAPIKey
methods.description: Retrieves test project data using the API key.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Returns all test projects, with optional filters and options such as order and output format.

methods.name: get_accessible_for_user
methods.description: Returns a list of projects accessible by a specific user, considering user roles and permissions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a test project and all dependent data, cleaning up related entities and database references.

methods.name: count_testcases
methods.description: Counts the total number of test cases within a specific test project.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays a Smarty template with test project info for user interface purposes.

methods.name: checkName
methods.description: Checks the validity of a project name for emptiness and forbidden characters.

methods.name: checkNameSintax
methods.description: Checks the syntax correctness of a project name.

methods.name: checkNameExistence
methods.description: Verifies if a project with a given name already exists, excluding a specified ID.

methods.name: checkTestCasePrefixExistence
methods.description: Ensures a test case prefix is not duplicated within the system.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a test project based on the provided status.

methods.name: formatTcPrefix
methods.description: Formats and truncates a test case prefix to conform to maximum length constraints.

methods.name: getTestCasePrefix
methods.description: Retrieves the test case prefix for a specified project.

methods.name: generateTestCaseNumber
methods.description: Generates a new sequential test case number for a project with locking to prevent concurrency issues.

methods.name: setTestCaseCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter for test cases manually, with an option to force update.

methods.name: setPublicStatus
methods.description: Sets the project's visibility to public or private.

methods.name: addKeyword
methods.description: Adds a new keyword associated with a test project, including audit logging.

methods.name: updateKeyword
methods.description: Updates an existing keyword for a test project.

methods.name: getKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific keyword by ID.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Returns all keywords linked to a specific test project.

methods.name: deleteKeyword
methods.description: Removes a keyword from the system with optional pre-deletion checks and audit logging.

methods.name: deleteKeywords
methods.description: Deletes all keywords associated with a test project.

methods.name: getKeywordIDsFor
methods.description: Fetches IDs of keywords linked to a specific test project.

methods.name: getKeywordSet
methods.description: Returns all keywords for a test project as a map.

methods.name: hasKeywords
methods.description: Checks if the test project has any associated keywords.

methods.name: exportKeywordsToXML
methods.description: Exports keywords as XML format for data sharing or backup.

methods.name: exportKeywordsToCSV
methods.description: Exports keywords as CSV format.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromCSV
methods.description: Reads keywords from a CSV file and imports them into the system.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromXMLFile
methods.description: Imports keywords from an XML file.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromXML
methods.description: Imports keywords from an XML string.

methods.name: importKeywordsFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Processes a SimpleXML object and imports keywords.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Returns a map of keyword IDs to names for a specific project.

methods.name: getUsedKeywordsMap
methods.description: Returns a map of keywords actively used in test cases for this project.

methods.name: getOptionReqSpec
methods.description: Retrieves list of requirement specifications for a project.

methods.name: genComboReqSpec
methods.description: Generates a hierarchical combo map of requirement specs for UI dropdowns.

methods.name: get_srs_by_title
methods.description: Retrieves requirement specifications by title.

methods.name: check_srs_title
methods.description: Validates if a requirement spec title is non-empty and unique.

methods.name: deleteUserRoles
methods.description: Removes all user role assignments for a test project, with optional auditing.

methods.name: getUserRoleIDs
methods.description: Gets role IDs assigned to users for a specific project.

methods.name: addUserRole
methods.description: Assigns a role to a user for a specific project and logs the assignment.
